verdictStatement: Almost everything I asked for at v10 is done, and two repairs are better than the fix I proposed. CLAUDE-V6-ADV-2 is booked not folded with a stated refusal to invent a backdated v6 remeasurement, which is the right instinct rather than the convenient one. The CODEX-V<n>-* alias is now documented, and I verified the practical payoff: four ids that needed hand-resolution at v10 resolve mechanically, and the full alias-aware sweep over thirty-six recorded findings returns no unaccounted id, so my v10 S-1 is structurally closed. Both v10 verdict records are accurate, and I confirmed the Codex one by opening the file this prompt permits, which closes the blind spot I had to declare last round. The contract is byte-identical to v10 across sixteen substantive keys, reMeasurementAtV11 is correct in all three values, and the roster holds at twelve changed paths. One thing fails. CLAUDE-V6-ADV-1 is booked folded on the strength of the universal sentence being restored, but that advisory had two halves, and the second — the '/date is on this roster and is unchanged' disclosure — is absent from v11's method while /date is in fact rostered and unchanged. The same array says so: entry [3] calls it 'the remaining' clause, even as entry [0] declares the finding folded and nothing lists it in notFoldedThisSuccessor. A coordinator building the outstanding list from that field will not see it. The remainder is four words, and adding them to the method sentence would make the fold true rather than merely asserted.

coordinatorNote: REJECT of the artifact, not a disposition of the row. DR-101 stays OPEN at file 08 line 283; nothing here mints D-096 (A) or any owner grant, and no implementation is authorized. This is a REJECT on a four-word omission and I want that proportion visible. The design contract has been untouched and correct for six versions and I re-derived it from live bytes again. The ledger is now materially sound: every recorded finding resolves to a column, the alias is documented so the ledger is machine-checkable for the first time, both v10 verdict records are accurate, and the live remeasurement is current. Add 'and is unchanged' to the /date clause in basedOn.method — or move CLAUDE-V6-ADV-1 to notFoldedThisSuccessor — and on my measurement this artifact carries zero blockers and zero SHOULD-FIX. I would fold ADV-1's one wrong date, 'at v9' where the bytes say v10, into the same edit rather than spend a round on it. Two standing items the coordinator should close outside this lineage: the Claude v6 verdict is still the only review at mode 0644 rather than sealed 0444, which matters more now that three successive successors pin it; and my earlier recommendation to specify the ledger's required shape once has largely been overtaken by events — v11's own reviewGuidance now encodes the checks as standing attack lines, which is a better answer than the schema I proposed and worth keeping.
